import numpy as np

def signbit_of_abs(x):
    return bool(np.signbit(np.abs(x)))

# Scalar NaNs
pos_nan = np.nan
neg_nan = -np.nan

probe('signbit_abs_pos_nan', signbit_of_abs(pos_nan))
probe('signbit_abs_neg_nan', signbit_of_abs(neg_nan))
probe('abs_pos_nan_value', np.abs(pos_nan))
probe('abs_neg_nan_value', np.abs(neg_nan))

# Dtype coverage
results = {}
for dt in [np.float16, np.float32, np.float64, np.longdouble]:
    x = dt(np.nan)
    results[str(dt)] = bool(np.signbit(np.abs(x)))
probe('signbit_abs_pos_nan_by_dtype', results)

# Array
arr = np.array([np.nan, -np.nan])
probe('signbit_abs_array', np.signbit(np.abs(arr)).tolist())
